long_description:
New Moon Sound Meditation

Plant your intentions. Rest your spirit. Begin again.

Join us for a soothing New Moon Sound Meditation designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and align with the energy of fresh beginnings. The New Moon invites reflection, renewal, and intention setting—making it a powerful time to turn inward, release what no longer serves you, and plant seeds for the month ahead.

Through gentle guidance, calming breath work, and the restorative vibrations of sound bowls, chimes, and meditative tones, you will be invited into deep relaxation and inner stillness. This experience is perfect for anyone seeking clarity, peace, emotional reset, or a sacred pause from daily life.

What to Expect

 New Moon reflection and intention setting

 Guided meditation for grounding and renewal

 Restorative sound healing with soothing vibrations

 Time to relax, reset, and reconnect with yourself

 A peaceful community space for new beginnings

What to Bring

Please bring a yoga mat, blanket, pillow, water, and a journal if you would like to write down your intentions. Come as you are and allow yourself to receive.

Reserve your space and welcome the New Moon with clarity, calm, and renewed intention.

Sound bath presented by Lisa Damm, from the Institute of Light in Racine.

New Moon reflection presented by Karina Ramsey

The cost is $30. If you need a yoga mat there will a be a few available.
